name: Deep Learning 3 — Practice Lab (Gradient Method, Neurons, Spiral Classification)
description: Guided learner workspace for the third lab of a beginner Deep Learning course (2×45 min), corrected 1.2 edition. The learner builds, configures and interprets the network; the data preparation and the evaluation figures are ready-made. Programs: environment check; the gradient method on one weight and one bias with synthetic data (L03_01); spiral classification with a hidden-layer-free baseline model (L03_02); a 16-neuron network and then two 50-neuron layers with a mandatory learning-rate experiment 0.01 → 0.001, everything else unchanged (L03_03); final evaluation of the saved, chosen model on the held-out test set (L03_04). Every run gets a short label (R1_baseline_lr0.01 … R4_50x2_lr0.001), the learner chooses a run by this label and justifies it from the validation loss, and L03_04 checks the choice against the rule before the test. The lab closes with 10 multiple-choice code-comprehension questions. Run with the Run button or from the terminal; everything runs locally, no Colab, no GPU needed, no homework.
